svg.title: Study for "Green Blue Red"
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and interpretive colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. The primary image shows red rectangular painted ground, green vertical form and blue pointed oval on a small paper support. External margin retained only as paper, not mounting mat. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red, green, blue, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.christies.com/en/lot/lot-5498495; record christies-5498495; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
